C-PLANS-LIFECYCLE-DESKTOP-252-V6.Summary: Expose current and archived plans as a persistent desktop segmented control while preserving the existing lifecycle select below 721 pixels.
C-PLANS-LIFECYCLE-DESKTOP-252-V6.Problem: On a working desktop the primary active/archive register is hidden in a generic select, so each switch requires an unnecessary menu open. Earlier candidates were based on stale main revisions and did not explicitly restore the original select when leaving desktop width.

Goals.Goal: Show `Текущие | Архив` permanently at desktop widths from 721 pixels.
Reuse the existing select, server-side `status=active|archived` query and lifecycle state as the only authority.
Preserve search and ordinary filters while preventing stale detail after a mode switch.
Restore the original select exactly below 721 pixels without introducing a mobile state machine.
Provide explicit keyboard, focus and empty states without decorative motion.

Constraints.Constraint: No API, SQLite schema, migration, plan lifecycle, archive/restore command, source-row decision, evidence or document-intake change.
No mobile-specific mode, navigation, bottom sheet, gesture or mobile-only transition is designed or implemented; below 721 pixels the existing select remains unchanged.
Lifecycle view is never-learn: statistics cannot select, reorder or reposition the modes.
No CDN, cloud, Docker, Internet or LLM dependency is added.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Redesign plan detail or source rows.
Implement reversible exclusion of extracted rows.
Create a separate narrow-screen navigation flow.
Rewrite general plan documentation in this micro-iteration.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `Текущие | Архив` is permanently visible at widths from 721 pixels and changes the register with one click, Enter, Space, Home, End or horizontal arrow key.
The legacy lifecycle select is hidden only while the desktop segment is active, remains the sole compatibility authority and is restored with its original attributes below 721 pixels.
Repeated DOM rerenders and width transitions create no duplicate controls or listeners.
The visible control uses tablist/tab semantics, correct aria-selected state, roving tabindex, visible focus and a minimum 44 pixel hit area.
The existing server `status=active|archived` parameter remains authoritative; the adapter does not filter a combined client-side list and stores no preference.
Search and ordinary filters survive switching; a selected plan absent from the returned set cannot remain in detail.
Empty active, archive and secondary-filter results use distinct operator text.
No mobile-specific feature or acceptance path is introduced; the pre-existing select is the only narrow-width control.
State changes remain complete without animation and under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Focused tests, desktop Playwright, full project CI and GRACE final pass on one exact head before squash merge, post-merge CI and terminal archive.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The exact branch head proves one-action desktop lifecycle navigation and exact narrow-width fallback through the existing status query without any data-contract or mobile-mode change.
